gaps.sentence: If only we ___ the tickets before they sold out!
gaps.explanation: 'If only' plus the past perfect regrets a missed past opportunity: had bought.

gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ to your advice — then I would not be in this mess.
gaps.hint: regret about the past, past perfect
gaps.explanation: 'Wish' plus the past perfect expresses regret about the past: had listened.

gaps.sentence: ___ there be any problems, call this number.
If you ___ me, I would have helped you move house.
gaps.hint: a missed request in the past
gaps.explanation: An unreal past condition takes the past perfect: had asked.

gaps.sentence: If it ___ for your quick thinking, the fire would have spread.
gaps.hint: the fixed phrase if it had not been for
gaps.explanation: The fixed expression 'if it had not been for' takes the past perfect: had not been.

gaps.sentence: If the route ___ safer, I would cycle to work.
gaps.hint: an imaginary present situation, subjunctive were
gaps.explanation: Unreal present conditions formally take 'were' rather than 'is': were.

gaps.sentence: I will be surprised if he ___ on time for once.
gaps.explanation: The if-clause of a real future condition takes the present simple: arrives.

gaps.sentence: If she ___ the lottery, she would travel the world.
gaps.explanation: Second conditional: if + past simple, would + infinitive.
